title: Going to a Wedding
content: I keep dreaming that I'm at mall world and I'm buying airline tickets to fly to a wedding. I'm with a huge group of people who are all going to this wedding. We buy tickets and go shopping for our outfits while we wait to board the plane. We then go into this futuristic airplane that is jet fast and has white leather seats with blue lights around the seats and across the inside of the airplane. We get there to the wedding and the location is called "Le Beau Chateau". A big beautiful house where parties are held. I looked that up and it means the beautiful castle! They usually have neverending tables of food and the party is just extravagant and Lavish. I wonder if anyone else has had this dream?
